excerpt: Prepare for Dubai off-plan handover by checking the notice, final payments, inspection, registration, utilities and ongoing ownership costs.
introduction:
Off-plan handover is the transition from a purchase contract and construction schedule to possession and ongoing ownership. Before collecting keys, check the developer's notice, the amount due, the condition of the unit and the documents required for registration and utilities. The exact process depends on the agreement and project.

This checklist helps organise the questions. Verify current requirements with the developer, Dubai Land Department (DLD), building management and utility providers, and obtain advice if a document or obligation is unclear.
takeaways: Reconcile the handover notice and final payment with the signed contract and your receipts.
Inspect and document the actual unit, agreed inclusions and any defects before completing handover steps.
Confirm registration, utility setup, keys, access and ongoing service charges for the specific property.

sections.heading: 1. Read the notice and reconcile the account
sections.body:
Check the unit number, proposed handover date, inspection appointment and deadline for responding. Compare the developer's statement with the signed payment schedule and every receipt. Ask for a written explanation of any difference, additional charge or adjustment. Confirm the verified recipient before transferring money.

Review the agreement's provisions for completion, handover, delays, remaining instalments and the consequences of a missed deadline. If a post-handover balance remains, put those dates on your cash calendar as well. The [post-handover payment plan guide](/journal/how-to-compare-post-handover-payment-plans-in-dubai) explains how to compare those obligations.

For a project-status check, DLD's [Mashrooi service](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/real-estate-project-status-landing/real-estate-project-status/) provides project information. Ask the authority to clarify any mismatch between the official record and the notice.

sections.heading: 2. Prepare the handover budget
sections.body:
Include the contractual balance due, any confirmed registration and connection charges, inspection, moving or furnishing, and a separate contingency. Ask for written quotes and distinguish a refundable deposit from a non-refundable charge. An off-plan payment plan can also continue after keys are collected.

Suppose a sample buyer has AED 200,000 due under the contract, AED 20,000 in assumed fees and setup costs, and a separate AED 15,000 reserve. The cash planned is AED 235,000. The values show how the example payment schedule works across the different stages of a purchase. The chart separates the components.

If finance is required, confirm the lender's valuation, final approval, insurance and disbursement timing. Do not assume a bank will release funds on the date you expect without written confirmation.

sections.heading: 3. Inspect the apartment and record defects
sections.body:
Bring the signed specification and floor plan to the inspection. Check rooms, finishes, doors, windows, cooling, plumbing, electrical fittings and included appliances where safely permitted. Record each issue by location and photograph it with permission. Consider an independent qualified inspector for technical concerns.

Ask how defects are reported, who acknowledges the list, the expected repair process and how a follow-up inspection is arranged. Do not assume that a verbal assurance changes the written agreement. The [Dubai apartment snagging checklist](/journal/apartment-snagging-checklist-dubai-before-handover) goes into the physical inspection in more detail.

DLD's [FAQs](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/frequently-asked-questions) discuss project escrow and retention relating to defects. This is not a substitute for checking the contract, current rules and the specific remedy available to you.

sections.heading: 4. Confirm registration and access
sections.body:
Ask the developer and DLD what steps and documents apply to your unit's final registration and title. Check the buyer's details, unit number and any mortgage or outstanding payment arrangement. A key collection appointment is not by itself proof that every registration step is complete.

Record the keys, cards, parking allocation, access instructions and meter readings. Ask when electricity, water, cooling and internet can be connected and who pays the relevant deposits and charges. Confirm the building management contact and procedures for moving in or arranging a tenant's move.

If another person will attend for you, verify the authority and identification required in advance. Keep copies of the handover record and all receipts.

sections.heading: 5. Plan for the first year
sections.body:
Request the current service-charge statement or approved budget, payment dates, insurance details, warranty documents and contacts for common-area and in-unit faults. DLD's [service charge index](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/service-charge-index/) can assist with approved charge information; confirm the amount and basis for the exact unit.

If you intend to rent the home, check the requirements for the lease and allow time for any repairs, furnishing and tenant search. Rental income is not assured from the handover date. If you plan to live there, include moving and ongoing utility costs in the household budget.

The [JVC and Arjan area guide](/journal/jvc-vs-arjan-apartment-investment-comparison) offers building-level considerations that also apply to comparing other Dubai communities.

sections.heading: Check the handover pack before leaving
sections.body:
Ask for appliance manuals, warranty contacts, the approved process for alterations and any building rules covering move-in, deliveries or pets. Confirm the procedure for reporting a common-area problem separately from a fault inside the apartment. If parking or storage is included, identify the actual space and record its access arrangements.

Check that names, unit details and contact information on the handover paperwork are accurate. If a promised document is missing, write down who will provide it and when, and follow up in writing. Keep the pack accessible to any authorised property manager who will deal with the home on your behalf.

sections.heading: Keep a clear handover record
sections.body:
Store the signed agreement, payment receipts, notices, inspection list, correspondence, registration documents and warranties together. Record outstanding issues, the person responsible and the agreed next update date. If a disagreement arises, seek advice and use the appropriate official channels rather than relying on an informal promise.

Browse the [Aliyas Dubai project collection](/projects?emirate=Dubai) or [contact Aliyas](/contact) to discuss a property and the documents to request. Verify project-specific obligations and current official requirements before taking action.
